name: GM - Spring Hill Manufacturing, Spring Hill TN

fieldNotes.facility: GM Spring Hill Manufacturing (former Saturn complex), 100 Saturn Pkwy. Largest GM facility in North America at ~11M sq ft on ~2,100 acres. Coords re-pinned from the roster's office-area point (35.7045,-86.922) to the true manufacturing core at 35.735,-86.9615 via Wikipedia (35.7371,-86.9579) plus satellite confirmation of the multi-building assembly/powertrain/paint/stamping campus. The audited perimeter covers the fenced manufacturing core, not the full 2,100-acre land holding.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Access is via Saturn Parkway, a four-lane divided highway that dead-ends at the plant and is restricted to truck and employee traffic only (per Saturn Pkwy extension reporting). A signalized truck-entry intersection feeds an internal approach road network with a controlled checkpoint before the secured core; classic guarded-campus geometry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Controlled-access automotive campus of this scale operates staffed security gatehouse(s) at the truck entry; booth-scale structures present at the road convergence inside the property line.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the Saturn Pkwy entry to the dock courts (hundreds of meters of internal road), easily holding a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Internal road network presents distinct in/out routing at the entry complex; loop road allows separated entry/exit. Lane counts (2/2) estimated from overhead, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron and multi-lane internal approach with ample unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+. Dock doors distributed across many faces of the integrated assembly, paint, powertrain and stamping/logistics buildings; banks of trailers backed in visible in the inter-building dock courts. Total count (~90) is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+. Multiple trailer-storage/staging lots on-site, including the west-face dock courts and the south stamping/logistics yard; well over 50 trailer positions.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound material receiving and finished-vehicle/parts shipping run from physically separate dock clusters on different building faces across the campus.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True campus: assembly, engine/powertrain, paint/plastics, and a separate large stamping/logistics building to the SW (~35.724,-86.969), plus the adjacent Ultium Cells battery plant cluster to the north.
fieldNotes.railServed: On-site CSX rail spur serves the plant (confirmed by GM facility material-handling cross-dock references and the documented CSX grade-separation/overpass project on the access route).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Spring Hill is a small/edge-of-town setting surrounded by farmland; classified Rural per rubric tie-break despite suburban growth nearby.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Campus-scale security implies an outer entry checkpoint then internal plant-specific checkpoints before docks; not individually resolved in imagery, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified in imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.streetView: Street View coverage exists on the public Saturn Pkwy approach (pano ~35.7312,-86.9628, captured 2026-02) but not at the interior gate/dock zones inside the secured campus; zone panos set hasCoverage:false to avoid attributing an off-zone pano.
